entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese packing context, all eleven turns and five hints against all twelve locales; checked bagged books, clothing gap filling, tracking and sender/recipient details.
Read police consultation context and all twelve complete target sets; checked three messages since morning, no reply/payment/link use, preservation of originals and no categorical fraud finding.

Compared all twelve locales with complete Japanese symptom-intake dialogue and hints; retained sensation, right knee, three-day onset, descending-stair aggravation and request for slower explanations.

Read complete Japanese certificate context and all twelve locale sets; checked fictional partial-household option, younger brother, one personal copy, omission of relationship field and current address.

Read all Japanese route metadata, eleven turns and five hints and twelve locale sets; checked two-minute concern, earlier 13:10 departure, twelve-minute transfer, unchanged 14:20 arrival and Aoba local only.
Read full park context and all twelve target sets; verified closed lawn entrance, paved outer path right, red drinking fountain landmark, gentle descent, blocked opposite side and same-route return.
Compared twelve complete locale sets and hints to detergent metadata and eleven Japanese turns; checked 400 ml at 200 yen versus 800 ml at 360 yen, same fragrance, two refills and reclosable pouch.

Read full bankbook rollover dialogue in Japanese and all twelve target sets; checked previous balance carryover, retention of old transactions, mark old cover only, preserve new machine-readable area, return both books.

Read complete Japanese envelope purchase scenario and all twelve locales including five hints each; verified unfolded A4, ten sheets, thicker envelope at 80 yen, address and enclosure before weighing, 200 yen postage after sealing.

Read full found-keys context and all twelve target sets; checked three keys on blue ring, station crossing around 11 am, right pavement viewed from station, no prior contacts and receipt-number enquiries.

Read complete Japanese dispatch-proof context and all twelve locale dialogue/hint sets; checked mailing-date evidence, no recipient-name requirement, Friday deadline, estimated day-after-tomorrow arrival without guarantee.

Read Japanese missing-bicycle context and all twelve locales; checked yesterday 18:00 parking, today 08:00 discovery, manager not moving bicycle, blue body/white basket, rear lock and changed address.

Read all Japanese scheduling turns and hints and all twelve locales; verified 14th Wednesday 09:00, same doctor 21st 15:00, pain worse since last night, retain current appointment pending physician reply, reachable until 17:00.

Read moving-in form context and all twelve locale sets; checked continuation field for building/room, rental contract evidence, room302, matching old address to moving-out documents and insurance counter after address acceptance.
Read Japanese station luggage route and all twelve locale dialogue/hint sets; verified south elevator opposite shop, blue sign, right at lower level, waiting room and keeping passage unblocked.

Read complete Japanese pollen-aware walk and all twelve locales; checked no pollen-free guarantee, pond shortcut before red bridge, indoor rest area until four, twenty-minute walk from three and return via bridge.

Read full Japanese frozen-vegetable label dialogue and all twelve locales; verified heat-required first item versus natural-thaw alternative, keep remainder frozen, no refreezing thawed food, forty-minute trip and ice pack at checkout.

Read Japanese chipped bank seal context and twelve complete target sets; checked passbook/old/new seals, ID, no withdrawal today, bank-only change distinct from city registration, old seal on tray and new seal in case.

Read full Japanese old-address parcel scenario and all twelve locales; checked forwarded mail versus other-carrier parcel, old-house occupant acceptance, unchanged online destination and checking both account and order addresses.

Read Japanese found-phone handover and twelve complete locale sets; checked claimed ownership unverified, unspecified police destination, staff identity/return handling, incoming-call history and desired seven-pm collection not agreed appointment.

changes.before: Ghi nhận và gửi trên phiếu này. Trước đóng cũng kiểm không lẫn đồ không gửi.
changes.after: Xin điền thông tin người nhận và người gửi vào phiếu gửi hàng này. Trước khi dán kín hộp, anh/chị cũng hãy kiểm tra xem có lẫn đồ không định gửi hay không.
changes.reason: Restore explicit sender and recipient roles lost in shorthand.

changes.before: हो, बाकस अलिक सार्दा पनि किताब नसरोस्, छेउ मेचमा गर्नुहोस्।
changes.after: हो, बाकसलाई हल्का हल्लाउँदा पनि किताब नसर्ने गरी राख्नुहोस्। छेउको टेबलमा मिलाउन सक्नुहुन्छ।
changes.reason: Clarify gentle box movement and packing table rather than chair.

changes.before: हो, मेच चलाउनुहोस्, धन्यवाद।
changes.after: हजुर, टेबल प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। धन्यवाद।
changes.reason: Use unambiguous table term in packing-table context.

changes.before: বলবেন, তিনটিই আছে পরেরও দেখাব।
changes.after: দয়া করে দেখুন। তিনটি বার্তাই রেখে দিয়েছি, তাই বাকিগুলোও দেখাচ্ছি।
changes.reason: Replace request to speak with request to inspect saved messages.

changes.before: Ghi lo đó. Đừng dùng liên kết hoặc số trong tin, hãy xem ghi hiện có.
changes.after: Tôi cũng sẽ ghi lại điều anh/chị lo lắng. Đừng dùng liên kết hoặc số điện thoại trong tin nhắn; chúng ta hãy kiểm tra các thông tin hiện có ở đây.
changes.reason: Restore clear instruction and phone-number referent from compressed text.

changes.before: डॉक्टर देंगे, प्रतीक्षालय रुकें।
changes.after: यह फॉर्म डॉक्टर को दे दूँगा। कृपया प्रतीक्षालय में इंतज़ार करें।
changes.reason: Restore object of handover and explicit waiting instruction.

changes.before: ให้แพทย์ค่ะ รอห้องพักนะคะ
changes.after: จะส่งแบบสอบถามอาการนี้ให้แพทย์ค่ะ กรุณารอที่ห้องรอนะคะ
changes.reason: Use waiting room rather than rest room for clinical waiting area.

changes.before: Bằng lái này. Xin một bản bản thân không quan hệ.
changes.after: Đây là bằng lái xe của tôi. Tôi xin cấp một bản sao phiếu cư trú chỉ có thông tin của tôi, không ghi mục quan hệ với chủ hộ.
changes.reason: Clarify omitted relationship field rather than person without relationships.

changes.before: 驾照这张，申请本人一份无关系。
changes.after: 这是我的驾照。我申请一份只记载我本人信息、不记载与户主关系的住民票副本。
changes.reason: Specify documentary omission instead of ambiguous no relationship.

changes.before: 駕照這張，申請本人一份無關係。
changes.after: 這是我的駕照。我申請一份只記載我本人資料、不記載與戶長關係的住民票副本。
changes.reason: Specify documentary omission instead of ambiguous no relationship.

changes.before: สิบสามสิบ ที่ต่อมีราวสิบสองนาทีค่ะ
changes.after: ออกเวลา 13:10 น. ค่ะ ที่สถานีเปลี่ยนขบวนจะมีเวลาประมาณสิบสองนาที
changes.reason: Disambiguate departure clock time from compressed concatenated numerals.

changes.before: หลังต่อคันเดิม จึงสิบสี่ยี่สิบเหมือนเดิมค่ะ
changes.after: หลังเปลี่ยนขบวนจะเป็นรถไฟขบวนเดิมค่ะ จึงถึงเวลา 14:20 น. เหมือนเดิม
changes.reason: Disambiguate unchanged arrival clock time and connecting train.

changes.before: สิบสามสิบ ต่อธรรมดาอาโอบะค่ะ ขอบคุณ
changes.after: จะออกเวลา 13:10 น. แล้วเปลี่ยนไปขึ้นรถไฟธรรมดาที่ไปสถานีอาโอบะค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
changes.reason: Restore clear departure time and connecting local destination.

changes.before: 红饮水处后有下池岔路。
changes.after: 经过红色饮水处后，会有一条下坡通往池边的岔路。
changes.reason: Clarify path leads toward pond rather than descending into water.

changes.before: 紅飲水處後有下池岔路。
changes.after: 經過紅色飲水處後，會有一條下坡通往池邊的岔路。
changes.reason: Clarify path leads toward pond rather than descending into water.

changes.before: 八百三百六十啊，拿这袋去收银。
changes.after: 八百毫升装是三百六十日元，对吧？我把这袋拿到收银台去。
changes.reason: Separate volume and currency instead of ambiguous adjacent numbers.

changes.before: 八百三百六十啊，拿這袋去收銀。
changes.after: 八百毫升裝是三百六十日圓，對吧？我把這袋拿到收銀台去。
changes.reason: Separate volume and currency instead of ambiguous adjacent numbers.

changes.before: แปดร้อยสามร้อยหกสิบนะคะ จะนำไปแคชเชียร์ค่ะ
changes.after: แปดร้อยมิลลิลิตร ราคาสามร้อยหกสิบเยนใช่ไหมคะ จะนำถุงนี้ไปที่แคชเชียร์ค่ะ
changes.reason: Restore units and currency to distinguish quantity from price.

changes.before: បាទ/ចាស សមតុល្យដដែលត្រូវបានផ្ទេរបន្តមកសៀវភៅថ្មី។ ចាប់ពីពេលនេះ សូមប្រើសៀវភៅថ្មីសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ពប្រតិបត្តិការចូល។
changes.after: បាទ/ចាស សមតុល្យដដែលត្រូវបានផ្ទេរបន្តមកសៀវភៅថ្មី។ ចាប់ពីពេលនេះ សូមប្រើសៀវភៅថ្មីសម្រាប់បោះពុម្ពកំណត់ត្រាប្រតិបត្តិការ។
changes.reason: Remove incoming-only restriction from future transaction updates.

changes.before: बाक्लो असी येन, ठेगाना लेख्ने मेच उता।
changes.after: बाक्लो खामको मूल्य असी येन हो। ठेगाना लेख्ने टेबल उता छ।
changes.reason: Use unambiguous writing table rather than chair.

changes.before: খাম দিয়ে ঠিকানা-ভেতর তৈরি করে ফেরা নিশ্চিত করুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.after: খামের দাম দিন এবং নাম-ঠিকানা লিখে কাগজপত্র ভরে ফিরে আসার ধাপটি নিশ্চিত করুন। জাপানিতে বলুন।
changes.reason: Restore paying for envelope rather than giving the envelope.

changes.before: ဘယ်သူမဆက်ဘဲရဲစခန်းလာယူကြောင်း ဂျပန်လိုပြောပါ။
changes.after: ဘယ်သူ့ကိုမှ မဆက်သွယ်ဘဲ သော့တွေကို ရဲစခန်းသို့ ယူလာခဲ့ကြောင်း ဂျပန်လိုပြောပါ။
changes.reason: Clarify bringing keys to police rather than coming to collect them.

changes.before: 寄申请表。提交方让我保留能知道在邮局寄出日期的凭证。
changes.after: 我要寄申请表。接收申请的单位要求我保留能证明在邮局寄出日期的凭证。
changes.reason: Correct recipient organization role instead of submitting party.

changes.before: 寄申請表。提交方讓我保留能知道在郵局寄出日期的憑證。
changes.after: 我要寄申請表。收件單位要求我保留能證明在郵局寄出日期的憑證。
changes.reason: Correct recipient organization role instead of submitting party.

changes.before: 请用那种。凭证带回，用来联系提交方。
changes.after: 请用那种方式。我会把凭证带回去，用来联系接收申请的单位。
changes.reason: Correct contact recipient role rather than submitting party.

changes.before: 請用那種。憑證帶回，用來聯系提交方。
changes.after: 請用那種方式。我會把憑證帶回去，用來聯絡收件單位。
changes.reason: Correct contact recipient role rather than submitting party.

changes.before: আবেদন। জমাদাতা ডাকঘর থেকে পাঠানোর দিন বোঝার কপি রাখতে বলেছেন।
changes.after: আমি আবেদনপত্র পাঠাব। যেখানে জমা দেব, সেখান থেকে ডাকঘরে পাঠানোর তারিখ বোঝা যায় এমন রসিদ রেখে দিতে বলা হয়েছে।
changes.reason: Correct instruction source from applicant to receiving organization.

changes.before: यो कोठामा कोड। अनुमान सुनेर तरिका रोज्छु।
changes.after: पोस्टल कोड यो खण्डमा छ। पुग्ने समयको अनुमान सुनेपछि पठाउने तरिका छान्न चाहन्छु।
changes.reason: Use form field rather than physical room for postal code.

changes.before: नीलो साइकल, अगाडिको टोकरी सेतो। फोटो र चोरी दर्ताको प्रति छ।
changes.after: नीलो साइकल हो, अगाडिको टोकरी सेतो छ। फोटो र चोरी रोकथाम दर्ताको निस्सा छ।
changes.reason: Distinguish anti-theft registration from theft report.

changes.before: အပြာစက်ဘီး၊ရှေ့ခြင်းဖြူပါ။ ဓာတ်ပုံနဲ့ခိုးမှုမှတ်ပုံတင်မိတ္တူရှိတယ်။
changes.after: စက်ဘီးက အပြာရောင်ဖြစ်ပြီး ရှေ့ခြင်းက အဖြူရောင်ပါ။ ဓာတ်ပုံနဲ့ ခိုးယူမှုကာကွယ်ရေးမှတ်ပုံတင်ထားတဲ့ အထောက်အထားမိတ္တူ ရှိပါတယ်။
changes.reason: Distinguish preventive registration from registration of theft.

changes.before: दर्ज मोबाइल ले सकता हूँ। आज पाँच बजे तक उठा सकता हूँ।
changes.after: दर्ज मोबाइल नंबर पर कॉल ले सकता हूँ। आज शाम पाँच बजे तक फ़ोन उठा सकता हूँ।
changes.reason: Specify evening to preserve exact 17:00 contact cutoff.

changes.before: दर्ता मोबाइलमा हुन्छ। आज पाँच बजेसम्म उठाउन सक्छु।
changes.after: दर्ता गरिएको मोबाइल नम्बरमा सम्पर्क गर्न सकिन्छ। आज साँझ पाँच बजेसम्म फोन उठाउन सक्छु।
changes.reason: Specify evening to preserve exact 17:00 contact cutoff.

changes.before: बसाइँ आउनुको सूचना लेख्दै हुनुहुन्छ। कुन कोठा गाह्रो?
changes.after: तपाईं बसाइँ सरेर आएको सूचना भर्दै हुनुहुन्छ, हैन? कुन खण्ड भर्न गाह्रो भएको छ?
changes.reason: Use form section rather than physical room in address consultation.

changes.before: ठेगाना कोठामा भवन नाम नअटाएको सल्लाह लिनुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.after: ठेगानाको खण्डमा भवनको नाम पूरै नअटेको कुरा बताई सल्लाह माग्नुहोस्। जापानीमा भन्नुहोस्।
changes.reason: Use form field rather than room for building-name writing space.

changes.before: জিনিসের ধরনটা ঠিক করতে চাই। অপেক্ষাঘরে একটু বসতে পারি?
changes.after: জিনিসপত্র আবার ভালো করে ধরতে চাই। অপেক্ষাঘরে একটু বিশ্রাম নিতে পারি?
changes.reason: Restore readjusting luggage grip rather than changing type of item.

changes.before: ខ្ញុំចង់កាន់ឥវ៉ាន់ថ្មីឱ្យល្អ។ អាចសម្រាកខ្លីក្នុងបន្ទប់រង់ចាំទេ?
changes.after: ខ្ញុំចង់កាន់ឥវ៉ាន់ឡើងវិញឱ្យស្រួលជាងមុន។ តើខ្ញុំអាចសម្រាកបន្តិចក្នុងបន្ទប់រង់ចាំបានទេ?
changes.reason: Avoid interpreting readjustment as new luggage.

changes.before: Use the rest room at the entrance. It is open until four today.
changes.after: You can use the lounge at the entrance. It is open until four today.
changes.reason: Use lounge to avoid restroom meaning toilet instead of resting area.

changes.before: It is three now, so I will walk about twenty minutes and return to the rest room.
changes.after: It is three now, so I will walk about twenty minutes and return to the lounge.
changes.reason: Keep resting-place reference unambiguous rather than toilet.

changes.before: Say you will return within the rest room's hours. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Say you will return while the lounge is still open. Say it in Japanese.
changes.reason: Keep task hint consistent with indoor resting lounge.

changes.before: Puwede ang rest room sa pasukan. Hanggang alas-kuwatro ngayon.
changes.after: Puwede ninyong gamitin ang pahingahan sa pasukan. Bukas ito hanggang alas-kuwatro ngayong araw.
changes.reason: Avoid English restroom toilet interpretation for indoor resting place.

changes.before: टूटी ट्रे में रखी। नई केस में है, कर्मचारी से जाँच कराऊँगा।
changes.after: टूटी हुई मुहर ट्रे में रख दी है। नई मुहर केस में रखकर संबंधित कर्मचारी से उसकी जाँच कराऊँगा।
changes.reason: Ensure chipped adjective describes seal rather than broken tray.

changes.before: ভাঙা ট্রেতে। নতুন খাপে রেখে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্তকে দেখাব।
changes.after: ভাঙা সিলটি ট্রেতে রেখেছি। নতুন সিলটি খাপে রেখে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত কর্মীকে পরীক্ষা করতে দেব।
changes.reason: Ensure broken adjective describes seal rather than tray.

changes.before: चोइटिएको थालमा राखेँ। नयाँ खोलमा राखी जिम्मेवारलाई देखाउँछु।
changes.after: चोइटिएको छाप थालमा राखेँ। नयाँ छाप खोलमा राखेर जिम्मेवार कर्मचारीलाई जाँच गर्न दिन्छु।
changes.reason: Ensure chipped adjective describes seal rather than tray.

changes.before: Xin đưa cả sổ và giấy tờ cho phụ trách. Cảm ơn đã tư vấn.
changes.after: Anh/chị cũng vui lòng đưa sổ ngân hàng và giấy tờ cho nhân viên phụ trách. Cảm ơn anh/chị đã đến trao đổi.
changes.reason: Correct gratitude for customer consultation rather than thanking customer for advice.

changes.before: Như vậy tốt. Cảm ơn đã tư vấn.
changes.after: Như vậy là tốt. Cảm ơn anh/chị đã đến trao đổi.
changes.reason: Correct thanks for consulting rather than thanking customer for advice.

changes.before: ऑनलाइन सुरक्षित पता न बदला समझाएँ। जापानी में कहें।
